// diagnostic

E0172

`{type}` does not wrap into `Dyn` automatically

What

`{type}` does not wrap into `Dyn` automatically

Why

Only primitive data and recursively wrappable collections wrap automatically

Fix

Write `Dyn.from(value)` (the type must implement `Encode`)

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0172: tests/ui/dyn_no_auto_wrap.stderr.
